prompt:
Add a 'code_owner' concept to the memory layer. This is a cross-cutting feature that touches multiple layers of the stack.

Requirements:
1. Add a nullable `code_owner` text column to the `observations` table in schema.sql (add the migration as an ALTER in the upgrade path, bump the schema version)
2. Update `data-access/observations.js` — the `insertObservation` function should accept and store `code_owner`
3. Update `src/memory-domain/observations.js` — the `save()` function should accept `code_owner` in options and pass it through
4. Update `src/memory-domain/search.js` — `rankObservations` should give a small boost (1.1x multiplier) when the observation's code_owner matches a query
5. Update `extensions/memory-layer/hooks/context-injection.ts` — when injecting context, include the code_owner in the rendered output for observations that have one
6. Update the `memory-save` tool registration in `extensions/memory-layer/tools/memory-tools.ts` to accept an optional `codeOwner` parameter

After making changes, run: npm test -- test/memory-domain.test.js test/services-observations.test.js --reporter=verbose

Make sure existing tests still pass. Only add tests if the existing test coverage breaks.

expected_facts.description: A code_owner column was added to the observations table
The data access layer was updated to support code_owner

constraints.message: Must not add external search/database dependencies
